Dana (People Ops): Heads-up — final week spike expected. We need a contingency for reviewer surge (13–15 Dec). Proposed: emergency reviewer pool + staggered handbacks + 48h 'on-call' reviewer shifts. Thoughts?
Leo (Eng Manager): +1. How do we onboard emergency reviewers quickly? Training doc?
Sam P: Can we avoid moving the EU deadline? timezone constraints mean finalizers in EMEA can't finish earlier.
Maya (People Ops): We can add an 'early handback' flag managers can set in the form so reviewers can prioritize. Also I'll publish a short 1-pager for quick onboarding — draft link: https://redwood.example/ops/review-emergency (will replace with canonical).
Ishan (HR Ops): For LOA folks: exceptions still go through the exceptions queue — manager fills exception form + cc peopleops@redwood.com, we'll mark reviewer exempt and reassign if needed.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: review forms close in 72h. https://forms.redwood/review - attachments disabled by default.
Dana (People Ops): Action items: (1) Maya to publish 1-pager + pickup list, (2) Ops to flip 'early handback' toggle in forms, (3) set reviewer-on-call rota in the rota sheet. Can someone volunteer to run the rota?
Leo (Eng Manager): I can run first shift this Thurs-Fri.
Sam P: I'll take Sat-Sun coverage.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks — I'll draft the onboarding doc and add a short checklist: 'how to score quickly', 'how to escalate edgecases', contact list. ETA EOD today.
Dana (People Ops): If any manager is offboarding before handback, ping me directly — we need to reassign their reviews before form lock.
Ishan (HR Ops): Note: for managers leaving, HR will hold a 24h grace window before auto-reassigning. Please include user IDs in the exception form.
Sam P: Confirming — do we allow partial handbacks? (i.e., handback 60% now, 40% later)
Dana (People Ops): Yes, partial handbacks ok; please annotate comments with 'partial-handback' and expected completion date.
Maya (People Ops): Quick template for managers: 'I have X reviews ready, Y pending (reason), expected handback by DATE' — I'll add to the doc.
Leo (Eng Manager): Great. One last Q: will reviewers from other teams be expected to cover during their PTO? just checking fairness.
Dana (People Ops): No extra comp for this surge; it's voluntary. We'll ensure rotation fairness and track hours in the rota sheet.
peopleops-bot: Incident: forms API returned 429 for batch upload earlier, now recovered.
Sam P: If we hit 429 again, fallback = manual CSV handoff to peopleops@redwood.com
Dana (People Ops): OK closing — will post final instructions and the rota link in #people-ops channel in 10m :thumbsup:
